notes: Cliopatria has no Boina. Two pages: Boina Kingdom (thin: founding c. 1690, Boina Bay, tributary 1820-1832, annexed 1840) and Sakalava people (Mahajanga 1824, division of the Sakalava kingdom). They disagree about the annexation (infobox 1840 against 'never annexed'); the dossier follows the Boina page. The Boina page has no capital other than 'Boina Bay', no Marovoay, no area. The af-07-a Merina dossier enters 'Sakalava kingdom of Boina' (a name, not this slug) for the Mahajanga gain of 1824; it should read boina-kingdom. Counterpart needing a dossier: the Antankarana kingdom (tributary to Boina, far north; the Boina page gives no dates). Gazetteer: names resolve (admin1 Boeny, Sofia, Betsiboka; place Mahajanga).
